tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Procurement of Water tankers for Water supply section, Davanagere city corporation. (FOR RATE APPROVAL ONLY)

itemList.description: Supply of Water Tanker of having following specification: Type of Trailer:2 tyres, Capacity of water tank(litre):5500, Net water carrying capacity(litre):5000, Material to be used for fabrication of water tank: Steel of grade E 250BR confirming to IS-2060 latest, Thickness of the water tank plate (minimum): 4mm, Gross Weight of the tank (kg):2000 kg, Overall length of trailer: Shall not exceed 5m upto 6 tonne load, 6.7m for above 6 tonne load, Overall width of trailer between extreme points: 2.5 metre, Overall height of trailer with tyre inflated from the supporting surface to top of platform (metre): 3 mt, Overall height of trailer with tyre inflated from the supporting surface toside board (metre): 4 mt, Ground Clearance (min): 300 mmm, Dealer should provide retro reflective marking tapes as per AIS-090, lighting device as per AIS 062, Ladder provision to be made on back side of the tank, Trailers shall be fitted with Rear under run protective device (RUPD) confirming to IS14812:2005, Trailor shall have service and parking brake as per AISD-043, The tanker shall have the provision of one main delivery valve and three taps (one on each side), The trailor shall be fitted with pneumantic tyre and rims of suitable size confirming to IS 13154:1991 and IS 10694 :1988 confirmity standards IS 8213:2000 with latest amendments, ISI marked ISMC 175mm x 75mm or better section shall be used for fabrication of chassis and frame mounting on chassis, necessory clearance from RTO for design of water tank to be obtained before supply of trailor, Warranty of 36 months to be provided for Construction Parameters, Type of of Suspension system: Frame type, Diameter of the axle chasis (Min) :100 mm, Number of spring leaves platted fitted: 15 nos, also provided with flashing hooks, towing device, MS painted colour on the trailor as per IS 112, painting on inner side and outer side of the tank as directed by the engineer incharge.

Supply of Water Tanker of having following specification: Type of Trailer:2 tyres, Capacity of water tank(litre):550, Net water carrying capacity(litre):500, Material to be used for fabrication of water tank: Stainless Steel of grade SS304 confirming to IS-2060 latest, Thickness of the water tank plate (minimum): 4mm, Gross Weight of the tank (kg):200 kg, Overall length of trailer: Shall not exceed 3m upto 1 tonne load, Overall width of trailer between extreme points: 1.5 metre, Overall height of trailer with tyre inflated from the supporting surface to top of platform (metre): 1.5 mt, Overall height of trailer with tyre inflated from the supporting surface toside board (metre): 2.5 mt, Ground Clearance (min): 300 mmm, Dealer should provide retro reflective marking tapes as per AIS-090, lighting device as per AIS 062, Ladder provision to be made on back side of the tank, Trailers shall be fitted with Rear under run protective device (RUPD) confirming to IS14812:2005, Trailor shall have service and parking brake as per AISD-043, The tanker shall have the provision of one main delivery valve and three taps (one on each side), The trailor shall be fitted with pneumantic tyre and rims of suitable size confirming to IS 13154:1991 and IS 10694 :1988 confirmity standards IS 8213:2000 with latest amendments, ISI marked ISMC 175mm x 75mm or better section shall be used for fabrication of chassis and frame mounting on chassis, necessory clearance from RTO for design of water tank to be obtained before supply of trailor, Warranty of 36 months to be provided for Construction Parameters, Type of of Suspension system: Frame type, Diameter of the axle chasis (Min) :100 mm, Number of spring leaves platted fitted: 5 nos, also provided with flashing hooks, towing device, MS painted colour on the trailor as per IS 112, painting on inner side and outer side of the tank as directed by the engineer incharge.
